doc: Time Machine scenario versions (T13, dev-spec §7.2). Each simulated version applies these scripted, deterministic deltas to the version named in based_on: landcover_transfers move percentage points between Dynamic World classes (taken from the source classes in proportion to their shares; tree cover removed is added to forest_loss_ha and forest_loss_last_12m_ha); ndvi_step_last_12m is added to the latest 12 monthly NDVI values before the mean, Sen's slope and Mann-Kendall test are recomputed; water_change_delta is added to the JRC change_abs mean; biomass_pct_change scales biomass_t_ha. SOC, area, cloud-free observations and provenance are carried over. Generated by scripts/precompute_sites.py; never edit the outputs by hand.

restoration.description: Community restores chinampa canals and replants native ahuejote willows on abandoned plots: 4 pp of crops and built land back to flooded vegetation and 4 pp to trees, greener last 12 months, canals re-flooded.

encroachment.description: An industrial park fills the wetland's edge: 12 pp of marsh, grassland, scrub and open water plus 0.8 pp of trees become built land, the last 12 months brown and surface water drains.

restoration.description: Hydrological restoration reopens blocked tidal channels and mangrove is replanted on cleared patches: 3 pp of grass and scrub become flooded vegetation, slightly greener last 12 months, more tidal water.

encroachment.description: A coastal road and fill for tourism development clear mangrove: 3 pp of mangrove (trees and flooded vegetation) become built land and 5 pp bare fill, the last 12 months brown and tidal exchange drops.

restoration.description: Assisted natural regeneration and native planting on the 2021-2025 loss scars: 10 pp of scrub grows into tree cover and the last 12 months are greener.

encroachment.description: The agricultural frontier and illegal logging advance: 8 pp of forest and scrub are cleared for crops and 2 pp for a settlement road, and the last 12 months brown.
